## Category

<!-- Tick one. These are the categories from CONTRIBUTING.md, in the order they get read. -->

- [ ] Framework gate gap — a decision that passes all eight and should not
- [ ] A real case where the written record failed
- [ ] Wording that misled a real reader
- [ ] Translation — bringing one language up to the other
- [ ] Typo, broken link, formatting

## The two rules this repository will check first

**Both languages say the same thing.**

- [ ] I changed `.md` and `.pl.md`, or this change touches only one language on purpose and I say why below.

**Adding a rule means cutting a rule.**

- [ ] This adds no new rule, **or** it adds one and I name the rule it replaces below.
- [ ] I understand that a `Why:`, an `Example:` or a `Note:` is not an addition and needs no counterpart cut.

<!-- If you added a rule, name what it replaces here: -->

## Checks

Run these before opening the pull request. Paste the numbers, not a reassurance.

- [ ] Relative links: 0 dead
- [ ] Emoji: 0
- [ ] Mermaid, if `guides/DIAGRAMS*.md` changed: 4 blocks, 0 failures, both languages
- [ ] Every file declaring a version declares the same one
